title: Weighed Down
description: This data pack adds weight to the player depending on how many items the player has in their inventory.
body:
# Weighed Down
This data pack adds weight to every item and entity in Minecraft! The greater your weight(the more items you have in your inventory) the slower you are and the lower you jump. This data pack also accounts for the weight of entities so mobs have low gravity and items will float!

**Watch out** your player can only hold so much weight before they **collapse** so don't let your weight meter go fully **red**!

### Weight Meter:

![Weight Meter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b2f922797a5746997676cd9cc6385b538294eef.png)

To turn off the data pack type:

```
/function weighed_down:turnoff
```

To turn it back on again type:


```
/function weighed_down:turnon
```
